description: React component for rendering a sidebar category in Mattermost, including drag-and-drop, accessibility, and category-specific controls.

classes.name: SidebarCategory
classes.description: React component managing a sidebar category with drag-and-drop, accessibility, and category controls.

methods.name: renderChannel
methods.description: Renders individual channel within the category.

methods.name: handleCollapse
methods.description: Toggles the collapsed state of the category.

methods.name: removeAnimation
methods.description: Removes animation class from the drop box after transition.

methods.name: handleOpenDirectMessagesModal
methods.description: Opens the modal for creating a new direct message.

methods.name: isDropDisabled
methods.description: Determines if drag-and-drop is disabled for the category.

methods.name: renderNewDropBox
methods.description: Renders the drop zone for new channels.

methods.name: showPlaceholder
methods.description: Determines if placeholder should be shown during drag.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method for the component, rendering category header, channels, and controls.
